purpose: Forward-model raw spectroscopic multiple-image positions under fixed baryon-only, fixed simple-MOND, locked universal-candidate, cluster-retuned RAR, and conventional GR-plus-halo deflection laws.
pre_freeze_disclosure: The Caminha et al. RX J2129 catalog contains 22 metric-neutral image rows in seven spectroscopic families with 0.196272-arcsec per-coordinate errors.
No candidate, MOND, baryon-only, or independent conventional-halo score has been evaluated on this 22-image catalog.
The separate Jauzac et al. 21-image catalog and the prior conventional engineering scores on that catalog are known and are not used for fitting or model selection here.
The published Jauzac et al. RX J2129 image-plane RMS of 0.29 arcsec and the existence of a 71-halo published model are known reference facts, not likelihood inputs.

raw_lensing_inputs.coordinate_cross_image_covariance: none published; use the declared diagonal errors

baryonic_inputs.density_600kpc_rule: continue the measured 200-400 kpc log-density slope; this correction was frozen after a pre-score count mismatch stopped the first execution
baryonic_inputs.interpolation: linear in log10 radius versus log10 acceleration or density
baryonic_inputs.inner_tail: continue the first measured log slope
baryonic_inputs.outer_tail: force g_bar proportional to r^-2 beyond 600 kpc and continue the last measured density slope
baryonic_inputs.warning: The Tian baryonic profile uses Chandra gas, HST BCG photometry, and a mean cold-baryon relation. It is independent of the raw image-position residuals but lacks a full component covariance and is not a completed same-system baryon reconstruction.

photon_closure.name: same_effective_potential_zero_slip
photon_closure.status: diagnostic closure rather than a derived covariant action

cluster_retuned_RAR_diagnostic.universality_status: fails because the scale is 16.83 times the galaxy value

GR_plus_cluster_halo.equation: fixed spherical baryonic deflection plus one non-singular isothermal ellipsoid and external shear
GR_plus_cluster_halo.interpretation: A deliberately compact conventional dark-halo comparator, less flexible than the published 71-halo RX J2129 model.

common_structural_nuisances.source_positions: two profiled coordinates per source family
common_structural_nuisances.classification: object-specific lens-geometry and source nuisances, reported separately from gravity-law or halo-amplitude parameters

predictive_split.training: images a and b in every family plus image 3c
predictive_split.post_score_rule: Do not alter the field equations, radial interpolation, tail closure, geometry family, bounds, or priors after inspecting heldout residuals.

optimization.method: bounded nonlinear least squares on first-order image-plane residuals with exact nonlinear lens-equation roots for scoring

primary_metrics: exact heldout radial RMS in arcsec
all-image descriptive radial RMS after a separately labeled refit

frozen_sensitivities.rule: Repeat the complete training fit and heldout score without selecting a favorable shift.

claim_boundary: The lens-side likelihood uses raw observed image positions and spectroscopic source redshifts and never reads a published NFW mass or residual.
The baryonic radial input is a literature reconstruction rather than a native joint photon-count and HST stellar-mass likelihood.
The pseudo-elliptical potential and external shear are structural closures not predicted by the scalar radial formula.
The labeled-root score is conditional on the known image associations and does not model missing-image completeness.
One cluster is a pilot, not a population test or a general victory over MOND or dark matter.
